controls.source_trace: Final image/bundle -> resolved dependency graph -> affected feature/config.
controls.controlled_verification: Use supplied runtime/client evidence and publisher advisory; report invisible backend graph as unknown.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Version presence is not complete reachability evidence; unsupported software is a separate risk.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Ship a supported fixed graph; verify the actual final artifact rather than only manifest text.

controls.source_trace: Name/scope -> resolver precedence -> locked source -> installation.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect supplied lock/source metadata or explicitly exposed client asset identity.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not publish a conflicting package; source inference from a name is insufficient.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Intended trusted source is selected reproducibly; private names cannot resolve through unintended sources.

controls.source_trace: Trigger/PR context -> checkout revision -> executed script -> secrets/permissions.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local workflow review and an isolated inert demonstration if needed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Read-only isolated builds differ from privileged execution of untrusted contributions.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Untrusted code never inherits unauthorized publishing credentials or release authority.

controls.controlled_verification: Compare approved out-of-band identity with supplied artifact bytes.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An adjacent attacker-supplied checksum does not establish origin.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Reject unknown/changed artifacts before consumption; reconcile shipped identity with approved release.

controls.controlled_verification: Review supplied build configuration; do not run unknown hooks to discover behavior.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A moving tag alone needs the relevant trust/update policy before severity assignment.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required dependencies/tooling have controlled origin, update ownership and proportionate privileges.

controls.source_trace: Advisory -> smallest supported upgrade/mitigation -> lockfile -> rebuilt artifact.
controls.controlled_verification: Validate delivered component identity and feature tests from supplied evidence.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A scanner disappearing after dependency removal is not proof of a clean final image.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Affected path is repaired in the shipped build; temporary exceptions state owner, scope and expiry.
